cohort: The study included 27 pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (28 0/7 -33 6/7 gestational weeks) and 53 healthy pregnant women.
finding: Oxidative stress is an independent risk factor in the development of preeclampsia and shortens telomere length in both placental and umbilical cord blood.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy/at birth when cord blood and placental samples were collected.
gest_age: 28 0/7 -33 6/7 gestational weeks (for the severe PE group)
